upload_diff_to_codereview: run upload.py to upload diffs from git, svn, or mercurial to the codereview app
guess_vcs_type: run GuessVCS to auto-detect whether the current directory is a git, svn, or mercurial repository
split_patch_by_file: run SplitPatch to split a combined svn diff output into separate patches per file
encode_multipart_form_data: run EncodeMultipartFormData to encode form fields and files into multipart/form-data for HTTP upload
run_shell_command: run RunShellWithReturnCode to execute a shell command and capture stdout output and return code
